evals.prompt: I want to write a survey paper on RIS-assisted near-field beam management. I have my references in a BibTeX file called myref.bib and I use Zotero for literature management. Please guide me through the process.
evals.expected_output: The skill should guide through the 9-step workflow: 1) Build references index using Zotero search, 2) Extract literature summaries using zotero_get_notes, 3) Deep analysis of important papers using zotero_get_item_fulltext, 4) Clear session, 5) Structure and write the paper, 6) Detail improvements, 7) Self-evaluation using 7-dimension rubric, 8) Iterate if score < 90, 9) LaTeX compilation.

evals.prompt: Help me improve my existing survey paper on terahertz communications. The paper is in latex/main.tex. I need you to evaluate it using your quality rubric and suggest improvements based on the 7-dimension evaluation system.
evals.expected_output: The skill should read the existing LaTeX file, apply the 7-dimension evaluation rubric (content comprehensiveness, structure, literature currency, critical analysis, accuracy, practical value, innovation), provide a score out of 100, and suggest specific improvements if score < 90.
